paite: Himahleh naute aw, ahun leh ani lam thute himhim gelhsak na kiphamoh kei uh.
heading: Toupa Ni

paite: Toupa ni tuh zan lai in guta bang in ahong tung ding chih noumau ngei in chiantak in na thei uhi.
Muanna leh bitna chi a agen laitak un numei nauvei bang in thakhat in manthatna atung uah atung ding a, asuakta kei hial ding uhi.
Himahleh unaute aw, nou zaw huai ni in guta bang a hon bingphawn ding in mial ah na om kei uhi.
Vak tate leh sun tate na hi vek ngal ua; zan a mi i hi kei ua, mial a mi leng i hi sam kei uhi.
Huaiziak in midangte bang in i ihmu kei ding uh, hak ni in limsak zaw ni.
Ihmute zan in ahi a-ihmut uh; zukhamte leng zan in ahi akham uh.
Himahleh eite bel sun a mi i hih ziak in, ginna leh itna lum tawi in, hotdam lametna lukhu a zang in limsak zaw ni.
Pathian in thangpaihna thuak ding hilou in, Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak a hotdamna mu ding zaw in ahon chi hi.
I hah in leng i ihmut in leng, amah toh i hinkhawm theihna ding in i sih sik in amah asita hi.
Huaiziak in kihanthawntuah chiat in, na hih zel mah bang un kitungdingtuah chiat un.
Huan unaute aw, na lak ua semgim leh Toupa a na heutu ua na omleh nou hon thuhilhte thei ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
heading: Kithuhilhna

paite: Anasep ziak un it in ngai thupi mahmah un. Noumau kituak in om un.
Tu in unaute aw, ka hon hanthawn uhi, dan lou a omte hilh unla, lungkete hanthawn un, hatloute panpih unla, mi tengteng lak ah thuakzoutak in om un.
Kuamah in kua gitlouh leng gilou a thuk lou ding in pilvang un; thil na kihihsaktuahna lam uah leh mi tengteng tung a na hihsakna lam uah leng ahoih lamlam zui un.
Nuam gige un;
tawp lou in thum un;
bangkim ah kipahthu gen gige un; huai tuh noumau lam a Khrist Jesu ah Pathian deihlam ahi.
Kha phelh kei un;
thugente simmoh kei un;
bangkim enchian zaw unla, ahoih lam peuhmah len tinten un;
gilou lam peuhmah ah kihemkhia un.
Huchi in lemna Pathian ngei in nou hon hihsiangthou sipsip hen; na kha uh leh na lungsim uh leh na pumpi uh i Toupa Jesu Khrist hong pai chiang in gensiatbei in humbit in omsuak sipsip hen.
heading: Vualzawlna

paite: Nou hon sampa amuanhuai a, hih leng ahih ding hi.
Unaute aw, hon thumsak un.
Unaute tengteng tawp siangthou in chibai hon na buksak un.
Hiai laithon unau tengteng kiang ah sim ngeingei ding in Toupa min in ka hon ngen hi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kiang uah om hen, Amen.
